recent_en: CVIEW declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 8 sen per share, with ex-date on 13 Nov 2026 and payment on 7 Dec 2026. The company also released its quarterly report for the period ended 31 Aug 2026. Substantial shareholder Puan Sadiah Binti Suleiman filed multiple changes in shareholding between Sep and Oct 2026.
